title: 639 Hz. The star only forms when both move

lines.text: 639 hz, the frequency of the heart
its old symbol is two triangles
one points up. one points down.
if only one moves, nothing happens
if only the other moves, still nothing
it only becomes a star when both do
twelve petals. one for every sign.

cta.sub: for the full 639 hz, ten minutes

caption:
639 Hz, the frequency of the heart 💗🎧

The heart's old symbol is a six-pointed star: two triangles, one pointing up and one pointing down, inside a lotus of twelve petals. Here every petal is a sign.

One triangle moving on its own does nothing. It only becomes a star when both move. It has to be mutual.
